clauses.text: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Maharashtra, India.
The Service Provider shall not, directly or indirectly, engage in any business competitive with the Company anywhere in India for a period of five (5) years after termination.
The total liability of the Company under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid in the three (3) months preceding the claim.
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, the Service Provider's obligations under Clause 12 survive without limitation of liability.

missing_clauses.message: No clause allows either party to terminate for convenience; consider adding a notice-based termination right.
No clause assigns intellectual property in the deliverables to the Company.
